O.outcome_detail: PENCRISAL total critical-thinking score; pre M=28.58, post M=31.70

cells.quote: The data show that in v.2 of the program a significant increase occurred in the deduction, practical reasoning and problem-solving factors and in the overall score of the scale.
cells.note: The intervention lasted four months; the post-test was administered one week after instruction ended.

O.outcome_detail: PENCRISAL practical-reasoning score; pre M=6.31, post M=8.40

cells.quote: It may be seen that regarding practical reasoning (d=.83) and deduction (d=.63) effect size has very high values.
cells.note: Practical reasoning was one of the dimensions showing a significant v.2 pre-post increase.

O.outcome_detail: PENCRISAL problem-solving score; pre M=5.56, post M=6.53

cells.quote: Likewise, the total of the scale (d=.48) and the problem-solving factor (d=.44) had a moderate effect size in v.2 whereas in v.1 these values were very low, ranging around .10.
cells.note: Problem solving showed a significant v.2 pre-post increase.

O.outcome_detail: PENCRISAL total critical-thinking score; v.2 post M=31.70 versus v.1 post M=26.65

cells.quote: The difference between the means of the improved version and v.1 proved to be statistically significant at p<.01 on the whole scale and on all the subfactors, except decision making.
cells.note: The v.1 and v.2 samples were from different implementations; the study reports no printed Cohen's d for this post-test comparison.
